title: The Trerrote Connection
summary: An unofficial tribute game to il Grande Maestro Tony Tammaro: deliver watermelons by Ape Car from Naples to Baia Domizia.
description: A tribute game for the myth of many generations, il Grande Maestro Tony Tammaro. Unofficial, made with affection by fans, and containing none of his music or lyrics. You drive a Trerrote, the three-wheeled Ape Car, from the Villa Comunale of Naples to the Molo Beverello in time for the ferry, through the lanes of Ischia with a load of 24 watermelons, then from Pozzuoli to Torregaveta, Mondragone and Baia Domizia. Dodge the potholes, the tamarri and the mozzarella truck. A melon that falls off keeps going: drive over it before a passer-by or another car takes it. Deliver to the stalls, and collect mozzariella, provola, ricotta, caciotta and a frittatina di maccheroni for Patrizia, who is waiting at the beach. A pseudo-3D road on a 64 KiB cartridge: 8-bit indexed colour, seven views painted after the real places, and an original eight-voice SID-like stereo soundtrack.
